description.value: Free Bird Table & Bar is a Southern-inspired restaurant in Richmond serving fried chicken, comfort food, and a full happy hour menu in a rustic, welcoming setting. The venue also hosts weddings and large events. A second location operates in Squamish. The OSM record tags this address as a beer/wine store (shop=alcohol), which may reflect a separate but co-branded liquor retail operation adjacent to the restaurant.

The website's Richmond address is 5991 Alderbridge Way, which conflicts with the OSM address of 5931 Alderbridge Way, casting doubt on whether the URL correctly corresponds to this OSM node. No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; an 'Order Online' link is the only amenity signal, applicable to the restaurant.
